note: Small city-run RV park next to the Historical Depot Museum at Laurel Park in Gowrie, within walking distance of the swimming pool and the Southeast Valley athletic complex. A basic in-town overnight stop. --Claude
summary: Booking changed reservable -> self-register FCFS (the clerk's reservation line is for park shelters); 10 water + electric sites confirmed; no rate is posted anywhere official. Not waterfront stands. Pin uncertain. Note trimmed.
flags: PRESENCE / PRICE (criteria): the city page confirms the park exists but posts no nightly rate, and no other source has one (aggregators carry none). With no price indicator, the live-web-presence rule may not be met. AWH to decide keep or drop, or call the clerk at 515-352-3999.

BOOKING: the stored reservable=true came from reading the city clerk line as RV reservations. On the page that line is for reserving a park or shelter for a get-together; the RV spots are 'Self register'.

PIN: stored 42.28227,-94.29033 is a downtown street intersection by the water towers. Esri imagery shows a row of ~8 RVs parked side by side on grass at ~42.2838,-94.2917, ~210 m NW. That is probably the RV park, but the Depot Museum couldn't be confirmed beside it, so it is a candidate correction only.
FIT / HOOKUPS: no pad lengths or amperage posted. The RVs on imagery suggest ordinary trailer-length spots. Electric amperage left unknown.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. It's an in-town park with no water nearby on imagery.
